_note: Search SEEDS, not facts. Each group lists medicines clinicians commonly consider for the associated problems, treatable causes and complications of a condition. A seed only tells the pipeline WHAT TO LOOK UP (FDA label by name, literature, web). A drug reaches the report only when a retrieved source supports it, and every dose comes from a label or source. 'when' is the condition under which it applies and is shown as a conditional statement.

items.when: persistent sleep-onset difficulty or sleep disturbance
severe irritability, aggression, self-injury or severe tantrums
certain seizure types, depending on the epilepsy diagnosis
